💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Hana.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 3 people, 17 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 5 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the northwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The northwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
🧳 A traveler says Stonebridge burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the northwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Aisha.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1545 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

⛓️ Stonebridge doesn't say no. They say: "They won't bow to Haven. But they'll TAKE Haven — 5,000 kcal/week, them primary. That's the offer." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Jamie speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
